verdict.rationale: The only telemetry opt-out evidence covers the separate Gemini CLI product's usage statistics, not the Gemini API or its SDKs. Paid-tier no-training terms and zero-data-retention controls are adjacent privacy features from other stories. Neither is an opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking for the API itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
